author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಾಡಿಮಿಡಿತವೆ ಬೇರೆ ಹೃದಯಬಡಿತವೆ ಬೇರೆ
ನೀಡಿಹವು ಕಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ತಂತಮ್ಮ ಕೊಡುಗೆ
ನಾಡಿಮಿಡಿತವೆ ಬಾಳು ಎದೆಯ ಬಡಿತವೆ ಜೀವ
ಬಾಡೆ ಬಿಡದಿರು ಬದುಕ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The pulse is one thing, the heartbeat another;
each makes its own contribution to the body;
the pulse is living, the heartbeat is life;
don’t let life wither, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The pulse and the heartbeat each sustain the body in their own way; one is the rhythm of living, the other life itself. Keep both alive, and don’t let your spirit wilt.
